content.subject: Month‑end reconciliation load
content.draft_text:
Hi Jon,

The CFO appointment highlights the importance of precise month‑end reconciliation. A tighter close can free capacity for strategic initiatives.

When month‑end close relies on manual matching across systems, the process often spills into the next day. Teams spend evenings reconciling duplicate entries that should line up.

We run a service that matches payment records across ledgers. The service writes the matched results back into your ERP, eliminating a manual step.

Does the manual matching cost you real hours each close?

Zamp
